title: zapret2-manager telemetry event (events.v1)
description: One event per line, ndjson, appended to /tmp/zapret2-manager/events.ndjson. Every event is SELF-CONTAINED: it carries enough context (actual values, threshold, cycle count, rc) to be understood WITHOUT consulting system state at recording time. Telemetry NEVER blocks functionality: if the events file is unwritable, the operation that produced the event still succeeds — see the file-level rules below. schema=events.v1. Closed enumerations are principled: parsing is built on `source` and `category` later, so free strings are forbidden.

schema.description: Schema version. Bump to events.v2 (new file) for breaking changes; never mutate v1 incompatibly.

ts.description: ISO-8601 with timezone, e.g. 2026-07-26T20:05:00Z. Wall-clock, not monotonic.

id.description: Opaque event id, unique within the file. `<source>-<pid>-<unixseconds>` is the producer convention; do not parse it.

category.description: What kind of event. Closed enum. New values may be ADDED; existing ones are not renamed.

source.description: Who produced the event. Closed enum — parsing is built on this field, free strings kill it. New values may be ADDED only by updating this schema.

msg.description: Human-readable summary, NOT parsed. Carries the self-contained context in prose (e.g. 'queue_total=87 > 50 for 3 consecutive cycles'). May change between versions.

restart_reason.description: NOT a top-level field name — this documents the closed `reason` enum carried by category=restart events. The taxonomy of restarts, as enum values (not free text):

restart_process_crash.msg: nfqws2 process gone; recovery start rc=0

queue_dropped_delta.msg: queue_dropped delta=12 (kernel could not enqueue packets; warn appears before queue_total grows)

queue_not_registered.msg: NFQUEUE 300 not registered in kernel (nfqws2 not connected)

guard_found_process_while_paused.msg: nfqws2 found running while paused; primary NFQWS2_ENABLE=0 mechanism did not hold; guard re-enforced stop

lists_rotation.msg: autohostlist log rotated to last 500 lines (was 1100000 bytes)

file_rules.format: ndjson — exactly one event object per line, UTF-8, newline-terminated. No pretty-printing.
file_rules.rotation: The watchdog rotates this file when it exceeds 1 MB, keeping the last 500 lines (same rule as the autohostlist log). Rotation is best-effort.
file_rules.size_limit: 1 MB before rotation; never let it grow unbounded on the flash-constrained device.
file_rules.never_blocks: Telemetry NEVER blocks functionality. Producers append best-effort: if the file is unwritable, full, or the directory missing, the append is dropped silently and the operation that produced the event still completes. A missed event is acceptable; a blocked operation is not.
file_rules.concurrency: Append-only; last-writer-wins per line. Producers do not read-modify-write the whole file under contention (the current event() helper does read-modify-write and is acceptable only because events are low-rate; a high-rate producer must use atomic append).
